title: Cycle 27 Round 1 independent hostile re-attack of A02/A03/A07/A13/A14

findings.title: Retained journal cache is mutable and does not authenticate interior bytes
evidence: A shallow strict-read snapshot mutated nested details later returned by _trusted_action.
Same-size interior tamper plus restored Windows file metadata left response_ready true and permitted append; a fresh restart rejected line 1.
A captured journal+witness+anchor bundle replayed successfully to an older state; this limitation is explicitly documented as residual.

findings.title: Terminal quarantine custody can commit an alias or lose recovery
evidence: A Windows hard link created after the final topology check remained present with nlink=2 while the journal committed status=applied and receipt destination_link_count=1.
A fourth/final topology-check exception left the source absent and quarantine object present, appended terminal failure, had no pending recovery, and restart reconciled successfully.

findings.title: Defender delivery cursor is not contiguous, durable, or restart-honest
evidence: Subscriber failure was swallowed, yet the row was acknowledged and cursor advanced; restart had no event.
A newer ready record overtook an older retry and the later retry regressed checkpoint 2 to 1.
Persisted coverage_complete=false restarted with gaps=0 and health=100.
Tampered outbox raised without a gap; deleted outbox silently recreated empty state.

findings.title: Read downgrade is fixed but mutation coverage and health remain overstated
findings.closed_boundary: Dynamic lure and runtime evidence now explicitly deny native read visibility.
evidence: Same-path replacement with changed bytes and restored mtime emitted no alert.
Deleting all canaries left health=70 and note claiming visibility active.

findings.title: Loaded-image receipt is an unauthenticated replayable digest
evidence: The same receipt value produced verified results for two different image hashes.
A hostile complete-empty provider with reported total_count=999 produced zero assessments and health=100 'driver provenance verified'.
